clean_reply_strip_llm_tags: clean an LLM reply by stripping XML-style tags like thinking, summary, tool_use, and file_content
extract_files_from_reply: extract file paths from a chat reply text by finding [FILE:filepath] markers
split_text_into_chunks: split a long text into chunks at line breaks respecting a character limit
format_restore_conversation: restore the most recent conversation history from log files in the temp directory
build_done_text_with_files: build a final response text by cleaning the reply and appending generated file paths
